title: Potion of Gaseous Form

sources.title: Gaseous Form (condition)
markers: Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak

summary: Drink to become a Tiny flying mist for 10 turns.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action, single use. Gaseous Form for 10 turns. Dismiss early as a free action.
fields.Mist form: AC 10 and Strength and Dexterity set to 10. Resistant to nonmagical damage, advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, immune to Bleeding. Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak. Ethereal prevents being shoved, thrown, or used as an improvised weapon.
fields.Fly: Move to a point up to 60 ft away, at half normal movement cost.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by eligible traders such as Quartermaster Talli, usually at level 9 or higher. No alchemy recipe.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
